categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: carbon materials, lithium battery materials, ceramic materials, and strategic resources. Carbon materials include carbon nanotube conductive agents, graphene conductive agents, and silicon-carbon anode materials. Lithium battery materials focus on ternary precursors and cobalt salts for battery cathodes. Ceramic materials cover ceramic inks and glazes for the building ceramics industry. Strategic resources involve cobalt and copper mining and refining in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced wet chemical refining for lithium battery materials and proprietary catalytic chemical vapor deposition (CCVD) for carbon nanotube production. It has developed unique technologies in single-wall carbon nanotube synthesis, high-nickel ternary precursor manufacturing with atomic-level homogenous co-precipitation, and ceramic ink nano-dispersion and micro-encapsulation techniques. The company also integrates AI-driven R&D and digital manufacturing processes to enhance innovation and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading battery manufacturers such as BYD, CATL, and international clients like POSCO Chemical. The company serves the electric vehicle, consumer electronics, and energy storage sectors globally. Ceramic materials are sold to major domestic and international building ceramics companies. Strategic resource products are sold to international trading firms and battery material producers. The company has a significant presence in both domestic Chinese and overseas markets including Japan, Korea, Europe, Africa, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Guangdong, Anhui, Jiangxi, and other provinces. It has overseas operations and investments in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Indonesia, Hong Kong, and Seychelles. Its sales network covers domestic markets and key international regions such as Japan, South Korea, Europe, Africa, and Southeast Asia, with overseas sales accounting for over 65% of revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the supply chain: upstream mining and refining of cobalt and copper (strategic resources segment), midstream production of battery precursor materials and conductive agents (lithium battery and carbon materials segments), and downstream supply of ceramic materials for building applications. It maintains integrated control over raw material sourcing, production, and direct sales to battery manufacturers and ceramic producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically focused on solid-state battery materials, the company invests heavily in R&D for single-wall carbon nanotubes, silicon-carbon anodes, solid and semi-solid electrolytes, and lithium metal anodes. It pursues AI integration in materials research and chip design, aiming to become a leading provider of full-material solutions for solid-state batteries. The company also emphasizes international market expansion, digital transformation, and continuous innovation in ceramic materials and battery precursors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of manufactured products including carbon nanotube conductive agents, lithium battery precursors, ceramic inks and glazes, and refined strategic metals. The company operates on a make-to-order basis with long-term contracts and direct sales to battery manufacturers and ceramic companies. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns but mainly relies on product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in carbon materials and lithium battery precursors, competing with firms like Tinci Technology, Putailai, and BTR. It holds a top-tier market position in conductive agents and ternary precursors with growing international market share. In ceramics, it is the only listed company offering a full range of glaze materials and maintains strong partnerships with major ceramic manufacturers. Its strategic resource operations compete with companies like Hanrui Cobalt.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 7.75 billion, a 6.25% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 156.86 million, a significant turnaround from prior losses. Overseas sales accounted for about 65.8% of revenue, showing strong international growth. The company’s total assets were about RMB 14.31 billion with a net asset increase of nearly 12%. It continues to expand production capacity and invest in R&D, supporting a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated industry chain control, advanced proprietary technologies in carbon nanotubes and lithium battery materials, and comprehensive product portfolios. Its single-wall carbon nanotube and silicon-carbon anode materials offer superior performance for next-generation solid-state batteries. The ceramic materials segment provides high-quality, innovative products like ceramic inks with nano-dispersion technology. The company’s global supply chain and strong customer collaborations enable it to deliver customized, high-performance materials with cost and quality advantages.
